--CETAS
-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS 


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

--CETAS
--CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS SELECT

--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas_2
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue_2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas_2;


-- order of execution--
--first data fetched from select query
--create an external source folder
-- then create the external table on the created folder

-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE

--EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
-- EXT FILE FORMAT
-- LOCATION

--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.revenue_ext_table;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(4000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(4000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = CSV_FORMAT

);

select * from dbo.revenue_ext_table;

SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;


SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/titanic.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS QUERY2;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_2
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(4000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(4000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'revenue2.revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = CSV_FORMAT

);

select * from revenue_2;

--VIEWS--

CREATE VIEW REVENUE_VIEW
AS 
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

SELECT * FROM REVENUE_VIEW;

--so far we have used openrowset to access the external data 
--but we are not creating any physical table or entity
--so if you want to access any particular external data again and again or from multiple locations then you have to use the openrowset function again and again
--it's always better to have a external table if we have any such use case


--EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT

--DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT PARQUET_FORMAT;

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT CSV_FORMAT
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS
    (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
);


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT PARQUET_FORMAT
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);

CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD ='password';

-- CREATE CREDENTIAL

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL SynapseCreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://sasynapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = SynapseCreds
);


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE enriched_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://sasynapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/enriched',
    CREDENTIAL = SynapseCreds
);

--https://sasynapsedemo.blob.core.windows.net/raw

--OPENROWSET FUNCTION

SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

--DROP TABLE dbo.revenue_copy_demo;

CREATE TABLE dbo.revenue_copy_demo
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
);


COPY INTO dbo.revenue_copy_demo
(
    Dealer_ID 1,
    Model_ID 2,
    Branch_ID 3,
    Date_ID 4,
    Units_Sold 5,
    Revenue 6
)
FROM 'https://sasynapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/enriched/cetas_revenue_2/'
WITH
(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity')
);

SELECT * FROM dbo.revenue_copy_demo;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_demo
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue_2',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source_dedicated_acfss,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT_DEDICATED
);

select * from revenue_ext_demo;
